note: Triennial election of North Down Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Nominations: the only contest was Ballyhalbert; in the Quintin division ('the Ards Peninsula division of Quintin'), vacant since 1958, James Joseph McMullan was returned unopposed after Mr. Eric James Meadowcroft withdrew; two newcomers, Mr. Henry McGimpsey and Mr. James B. Caughey, were returned unopposed; Mr. John Martin did not seek re-election (Belfast Telegraph, 20 May 1964, p. 4). Returned unopposed (new member). The 1964 report does not name his division; it is Kilmood, where he lives and where the 1967 results call him the 'sitting member' (Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 4) (inferred).
